_about: Crafting costs by damage output. A gun whose damage a second (over a magazine and its reload) is outlier_from times the median of its Age or more needs a rare part, one more for each further step, at most max_units; Ages with fewer than min_peers guns are not judged. A recipe that already asks for one of rare_items is left as its author made it.
_attachments: Attachments that raise a gun's damage are not sold at the attachment table, except those of the gun packs listed here (by id namespace) and those at an Age up to damage_attachments_kept_up_to_age.
_armor: Armor prices by protection. A piece's score is the armor a full set of it keeps against one hit of armor_reference_hit damage, as the game counts it (0 to 20), with up to a tenth more for knockback resistance. It is compared with the median score of its Age as (score + armor_soften) / (median + armor_soften); the piece pays that share of its Age's set price, kept between armor_price_min and armor_price_max, and a rare part like a gun at outlier_from and above.
